author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 1. The body argues Chinese model price pressure hits Mag 7 margins: 'taking down a frighteningly concentrated S&P'. An AI-stock correction in 2026.

quote: likely sending the U.S., possibly the globe, into recession.
author: Scott Galloway
context: Prediction 1, consequence clause, split from c1. A US recession in 2026 following the AI correction. Hedged with 'likely'.

author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 2. The body argues grid and power capacity cannot support announced build-outs (OpenAI/Oracle $300B). Data-center build-out plans collapse or are cut sharply in 2026.

quote: Nvidia & OpenAI Duopoly Comes Under Siege
author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 3. Body: Chinese models, Anthropic's enterprise lead and Alphabet erode both companies' positions; 'OpenAI could be our era's Netscape'.

author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 4. 'I'm bullish on Amazon, even though it underperformed the Mag 7 this year.' Amazon outperforms the other Mag 7 stocks in 2026.

author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 5. Body: launch costs down 89%, private space investment up 6x, SpaceX 84% of US launches. Space becomes the next major investment theme in 2026.

quote: Best Investment (You Don’t Have Access to): TikTok U.S.
author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 6. Body: 'Trump's deal values U.S. TikTok at $28 billion' against an implied $120 billion. The US TikTok stake is the best investment of 2026, i.e. it proves to be worth far more than $28 billion.

quote: Short-Form Video and AI Meteors Strike Hollywood
author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 7. Body: YouTube and TikTok take young viewers (78% of 10 to 24 year olds), AI cuts production costs; 'Hollywood is the new Detroit'. Visible damage to studios and networks in 2026.

quote: When Colbert shifts to podcasting, he’ll take eight people with him and make just $20 million, but it’ll only cost $5 million to produce.
author: Scott Galloway
context: Prediction 7, specific example, split from c8. Stephen Colbert moves to podcasting after The Late Show ends.

author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 8. Body: 1 million paid rides a month, 100 million autonomous miles vs Tesla's 1.25 million with monitors; 'lapping the competition'. Waymo extends its lead in 2026.

author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 9. Body: Optimus is a 'weapon of mass distraction'; humanoids are a decade out. Humanoid robots do not ship commercially at scale in 2026 and Tesla's claims go unmet.

quote: Vice of the Year: Prediction Markets
author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 10. Body: prediction markets are gambling, eating the gaming business (six gaming stocks down 22% YTD), with addiction and insider-trading externalities. Prediction markets grow and become the year's vice story in 2026.

author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 11. Body: AI companions help isolated elderly, harm young people; 'the next opioid crisis for young people'. AI companions become a central public and policy issue in 2026.

author: Scott Galloway
context: Heading of prediction 12. Body: enrollment has rebounded, the degree premium holds; the problem is cost. The 'college is dead' narrative loses in 2026 as enrollment and the wage premium hold up.

quote: Team Scotland will reach the semifinals of the World Cup on the back of a Pele-like performance from Scott McTominay.
author: Scott Galloway
context: Closing line, offered with 'Hey ... I can dream.' The 2026 World Cup final was 2026-07-19. Kept because it is the only clean binary on the list and because he wrote it down.
